
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiaoyan2017/p/19136187" title="发布于 2025-10-12 00:44">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Electron38-Vue3OS客户端OS系统|vite7+electron38+arco桌面os后台管理</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-size: 18px; font-family: 宋体, &quot;Songti SC&quot;; color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1)">最新研发<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">electron38+vite7+arco-design</span>电脑端os后台管理<em>ElectronViteOS</em>。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px"><strong>vite7-electron38-os</strong>最新款<span style="background-color: rgba(204, 255, 255, 1)">vite7.1+electron38.2+vue3 setup+pinia3+arcoDesign+echarts</span>实战仿<strong>macOS</strong>/<strong>windows</strong>风格桌面os管理系统Exe模板。<span style="background-color: rgba(231, 250, 178, 1)">自研可拖拽栅格布局结构、自定义JSON配置桌面菜单/Dock菜单</span>。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251011233121581-2035832499.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="002360截图20251010230146790" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251011233232779-619654289.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>使用技术</h3>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">编码工具：vscode</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">跨平台框架：electron^38.2.0</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">前端技术框架：vite^7.1.7+vue^3.5.21+vue-router^4.5.1</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">组件库：@arco-design/web-vue^2.57.0 (字节前端vue3组件库)</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">状态管理：pinia^3.0.3</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">拖拽插件：sortablejs^1.15.6</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">图表组件：echarts^6.0.0</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">markdown编辑器：md-editor-v3^6.0.1</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">模拟数据：mockjs^1.1.0</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">打包构建：electron-builder^24.13.3</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">electron+vite插件：vite-plugin-electron^0.29.0</span></li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="p2" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251011233648571-129044824.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="p3-1" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251011233704495-1877671554.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>功能特点</h3>
<ol>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">Electron38封装高复用多开窗口管理</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">支持macOS/Windows两种桌面风格</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">支持自定义json配置桌面菜单和Dock菜单</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">自研桌面栅格化拖拽布局引擎</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">自定义桌面个性化壁纸、全场景毛玻璃模糊效果</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">支持独立新开窗口打开路由页面</span></li>
</ol>
<p><img alt="p3-4" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251011233941372-181567144.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>项目结构目录</h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">electron38-vue3-os使用&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">Vite7.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.7</span></span>&nbsp;整合&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">Electron38</span>&nbsp;跨平台框架搭建项目模板，采用<em><strong>vue3 setup</strong></em>语法糖风格编码开发。</span></p>
<p><img alt="360截图20251010223344923" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251011234359786-165673009.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<h3>Electron主进程配置</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251011235132647-575026350.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * electron主线程配置
 * @author andy
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

import { app, BrowserWindow } from </span>'electron'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

import { WindowManager } from </span>'../src/windows/index.js'

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 忽略安全警告提示 Electron Security Warning (Insecure Content-Security-Policy)</span>
process.env['ELECTRON_DISABLE_SECURITY_WARNINGS'] = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

const createWindow </span>= () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  let win </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WindowManager()
  win.create({isMajor: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">})
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 系统托盘管理</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  win.trayManager()
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 监听ipcMain事件</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  win.ipcManager()
}

app.whenReady().then(() </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  createWindow()

  app.on(</span>'activate', () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().length === 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) createWindow()
  })
})

app.on(</span>'window-all-closed', () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(process.platform !== 'darwin'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) app.quit()
})</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="002360截图20251010225357519" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251011235554839-661714912.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="024360截图20251011091444081" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251011235726523-1883538312.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>项目入口配置main.js</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>import { createApp } from 'vue'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import </span>'./style.scss'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import App from </span>'./App.vue'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

import { launchApp } from </span>'@/windows/actions'

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入路由及状态管理</span>
import Router from './router'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import Pinia from </span>'./pinia'

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入插件</span>
import Plugins from './plugins'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

launchApp().then(config </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(config) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 全局存储窗口配置</span>
    window.config =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> config
  }

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化app实例</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  createApp(App)
  .use(Router)
  .use(Pinia)
  .use(Plugins)
  .mount(</span>'#app'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
})</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>ElectronOS桌面布局模板</h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">内置了<strong>macOS</strong>/<strong>windows</strong>两种风格桌面布局模板。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251012000214148-268254914.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 桌面模板 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">setup</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  import { appState } from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@/pinia/modules/app</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>

  <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入布局模板</span>
<span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  import MacosLayout from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">./template/macos.vue</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  import WindowsLayout from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">./template/windows.vue</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

  const appstate </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> appState()

  const DeskLayout </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    macos: MacosLayout,
    windows: WindowsLayout
  }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="vu__container"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> :style</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="{'--themeSkin': appstate.config.skin}"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">component </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">:is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="DeskLayout[appstate.config.layout]"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>

<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">setup</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  import Wintool from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@/layouts/components/wintool/index.vue</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  import Desk from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@/layouts/components/mac/desk.vue</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  import Dock from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@/layouts/components/mac/dock.vue</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="vu__layout flexbox flex-col"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="vu__layout-header"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Wintool </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="vu__layout-body flex1 flexbox"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Desk </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>

<h3>electron-vue3os栅格桌面布局</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251012003008758-1133124589.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251012003033421-312238492.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251012003127193-1234414321.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>自定义桌面图标变量</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>const deskGridVariable =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ref({
  </span>'--icon-radius': '10px', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 圆角</span>
  '--icon-size': '60px', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 图标尺寸</span>
  '--icon-gap-col': '30px', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 水平间距</span>
  '--icon-gap-row': '30px', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 垂直间距</span>
  '--icon-labelSize': '12px', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 标签文字大小</span>
  '--icon-labelColor': '#fff', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 标签颜色</span>
  '--icon-fit': 'contain', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 图标自适应模式</span>
})</pre>
</div>
<p><strong>桌面json配置参数</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*

 * @param label 图标标题
 * @param imgico 图标(本地或网络图片) 支持ArcoDesign内置图标或自定义iconfont图标
 * @param path 跳转路由页面
 * @param link 跳转外部链接
 * @param hideLabel 是否隐藏图标标题
 * @param filter 是否禁用拖拽
 * @param background 自定义图标背景色
 * @param color 自定义图标颜色
 * @param size 栅格磁贴布局(16种) 1x1 ... 12x12
 * @param padding 内边距
 * @param onClick 点击图标回调函数
 * @param isNewin 新窗口打开路由页面
 * @param children 二级菜单
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span></pre>
